name: LaBeau's Famous Bear Lake Fresh Raspberry Shake (Seed & Dairy Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: LaBeau's / LaBeau's Too / Hometown Drive In (Garden City, UT)
whyItWorks: Bear Lake's most famous tradition, but blended whole fresh raspberries pack thousands of hard, insoluble drupelet seeds alongside heavy dairy ice cream.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during flares due to gritty raspberry seeds; in remission, share a small size with a double dose of Lactaid, or swap to a seedless Banana or Chocolate Malt shake.
watchOuts: Thousands of insoluble raspberry seeds (diverticular/mucosal irritant)
High lactose and dairy fat in thick ice cream base
